command: python -m certreq run vendor/industrial-ai-hackathon/cases/dev-rear-lamp --vision on --filters all --extract modal,llm --out out/E018-a.json

selection.reason: The specified rear-position, stop and reversing lamps fall within this consolidated regulation, including requirements for their photometric performance and emitted colours through the outer lens.
The integrated passive retro-reflector must meet the applicable retro-reflective-device requirements, notwithstanding uncertainty about its location in the drawing.

Installation on the M1 vehicle must satisfy the applicable positioning, orientation, geometric visibility and electrical-connection requirements for the rear-position, stop and reversing lamps and retro-reflector.
The specified LED modules on PCBs form an electrical/electronic lamp assembly whose emissions and immunity must satisfy the applicable electromagnetic-compatibility provisions.
The exterior rear lens, housing and perimeter rim must satisfy applicable M1 external-projection requirements for exposed contours in their installed position.
Integration of the stop-lamp function must accommodate the braking-system requirements governing generation of the signal that illuminates the stop lamps.
The rear lamp's placement and protection must allow the lighting and signalling devices to remain operational and visible following the prescribed low-speed rear-impact test.
Its rear-position and stop-lamp provisions are consolidated into UN R148, which is selected instead.
Its reversing-lamp provisions are consolidated into UN R148, which is selected instead.
Its retro-reflector provisions are consolidated into UN R150, which is selected instead.
PCB-mounted LED modules are not identified as standardized Annex 1 LED light sources, so LED technology alone does not establish applicability of separate UN R128 source approval.
The scope explicitly excludes glazing for lighting and light-signalling devices, including this lamp's outer lens.

drawing.product: Rear lamp assembly, shown with internal optical features exposed in the upper view and an outer lens in the lower view.
drawing.vehicle_location: Exterior rear of the vehicle. The drawing does not establish the vehicle side or exact mounting position.

parts.name: Housing and perimeter rim
parts.function: Supports and encloses the lamp's optical units and provides the perimeter interface for the outer lens.
parts.technology: Likely molded plastic housing; exact material is not identifiable.
parts.evidence: Both views have a matching broad, asymmetric outline with a rounded upper edge, sloping left end, and nested perimeter borders.

parts.name: Outer lens
parts.function: Covers the internal units and transmits their light.
parts.technology: Transparent molded lens; polymer type and tint are not shown.
parts.evidence: The lower view shows a continuous cover with diagonal reflection strokes and an outline matching the exposed assembly above.

parts.name: Upper row of eight light-source cells
parts.function: Provides one of the rear signalling light outputs, potentially rear position or stop lighting.
parts.technology: Likely discrete LED sources in individual optical cells; source technology is not conclusive.
parts.evidence: Eight repeated upright rectangular compartments each contain a small circular feature near the lower portion.

parts.name: Three-row optical array
parts.function: Collects and distributes light for rear signalling, potentially rear position or stop lighting.
parts.technology: Twenty-four cup-shaped reflector or lens elements; reflective coating and source construction are not established.
parts.evidence: Below the upper source row are three horizontal rows of eight oval, bowl-like elements with radial and transverse surface lines.

parts.name: Internal carrier and separating ribs
parts.function: Locates the repeated optical elements and separates adjacent rows and compartments.
parts.technology: Likely molded structural carrier or bezel.
parts.evidence: Horizontal rails separate the optical rows, while vertical walls divide the upper cells and border the array.

parts.name: Central rectangular panel
parts.function: Forms a separate optical or trim region; its specific function cannot be assigned.
parts.technology: Flat panel or insert of undetermined material.
parts.evidence: A plain upright rectangle with a stepped border lies immediately to the right of the repeated optical array.

parts.name: Elongated upper insert
parts.function: Provides a separate optical or trim region; it could be the retro-reflector, but that identification is uncertain.
parts.technology: Molded insert; no retro-reflective prism structure is resolved.
parts.evidence: A long, narrow, separately outlined feature runs across the upper interior, with a tapered left end and rounded right end.

parts.name: Right-hand lamp compartment
parts.function: Likely provides reversing illumination through the corresponding localized lens region.
parts.technology: Reflector-type optical cavity with a circular source or source opening; bulb versus LED cannot be determined.
parts.evidence: The upper view shows an isolated rounded-rectangular cavity with a gridded curved upper surface, a circular feature at its top, and a broad lower reflector surface.

parts.name: Ribbed lens window
parts.function: Transmits and shapes light from the right-hand compartment.
parts.technology: Vertically fluted molded optical region, either integral with the outer lens or a separate insert.
parts.evidence: The lower view contains a rounded-rectangular window with parallel vertical lines, aligned with the right-hand internal compartment.

uncertainties: The drawing does not establish which repeated optical group performs rear position lighting and which performs stop lighting, or whether they share functions.
The specified retro-reflector cannot be positively located: no unmistakable prism pattern is shown.
The right-hand compartment is consistent with a reversing lamp, but no labels or colors confirm that assignment.
Lens colors, exact materials, reflective finishes, dimensions, and light-source technologies cannot be determined from the line drawing.
No circuit boards, wiring, connectors, seals, fasteners, or vehicle mounting brackets are visibly detailed.
The two views appear to show the same assembly without and with its outer lens, but the drawing provides no explicit assembly labels.
